enpi_enb_model_types.evidence_quote: thermal energy consumption (Sm3/t), and total energy consumption (GJ/t) for ACC, FOR, LAM, and TT, GJ/t for RIF

normalisation_variables.evidence_quote: the production of kilo tons of steel at five different stages

baseline_construction_method.value: Energy consumption of each equipment is summed to obtain each process's total energy, then converted to Tera joule (TJ) using regional emission factors and expressed as specific energy-consumption EnPIs (per tonne of steel) that are benchmarked against literature values; no regression baseline model is fitted.
baseline_construction_method.evidence_quote: By calculating the energy consumption of each equipment the total energy of the process is calculated. The energy consumption is then converted to Tera joul (TJ) by using the emission factors of that region for the sake of comparison.

validation_types.evidence_quote: The computed EnpIs are then compared with the literature available.

scale_of_application.evidence_quote: It has been done on process and mill level.

scope_description.value: The steel manufacturing process of two steel mills, categorized into mill level, system flows and processes (steelmaking, casting, conditioning, forging, hot rolling, heat treatment, surface treatment, cold working, peeling, reeling).
scope_description.evidence_quote: The steel manufacturing process (SMP) is categorized into m different processes mainly steelmaking, casting, conditioning, forging, hot rolling, heat treatment, surface treatment, cold working, peeling, and reeling.
